title: Tanzanian Avocado Smoothie
community: Urban Tanzania — the modern health drink
author: Chef Jabir
desc: Tanzanian Avocado Smoothie — ripe Tanzanian avocado blended with banana, coconut milk, honey, and lime into a thick, creamy, intensely nutritious drink. Tanzania grows exceptional avocados — this is the most indulgent way to drink them.
longDesc: Tanzania is a major avocado producer, and the avocado smoothie has become one of the most popular health drinks at urban juice bars. The Tanzanian version uses coconut milk for richness, banana for natural sweetness, and lime to prevent browning — producing a thick, green, completely satisfying drink.
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend on high for 60 seconds until completely smooth.
chefTips: Add lime juice first — it prevents the avocado from browning in the blender.
Frozen banana makes it even thicker and colder.
Serve immediately — avocado oxidises quickly once blended.
commonMistakes: Waiting to serve — turns brown and loses flavour.
cookingScience: See KEN229 for avocado browning science. Blending ruptures avocado cell walls, releasing polyphenol oxidase — which rapidly oxidises in contact with air. Adding lime juice immediately inhibits this enzyme through pH reduction, maintaining the green colour for longer.
sustainabilityTips: Tanzania's avocados — one of the country's major export crops, consumed at the source.
healthBenefits: Very high in healthy monounsaturated fats.
Vitamins K, C, B6, and folate.
culturalNote: Avocado smoothie is Tanzania's modern health drink — at the urban juice bars of Dar es Salaam and Arusha, it is the most ordered item by the country's growing health-conscious middle class.
